root_cause: The test failed due to a read timeout when attempting to connect to the TMDB API
suggested_fix: Increase the read timeout value or check the network connectivity and API server status, consider setting a retry mechanism for transient issues
explanation: The error message indicates a ReadTimeout exception, which occurs when the API request takes longer than the specified timeout period to respond. This could be due to network issues, API server overload, or a problem with the test environment. Increasing the timeout value or implementing a retry mechanism can help mitigate this issue
